pedestals: In the spring or warmer weather when the snow thaws in the woods the tracks of winter reappear on slender pedestals and the snow reveals in palimpsest old buried wanderings, struggles, scenes of death. Tales of winter brought to light again like time turned back upon itself.
pedigree:
The pedigree of honey
Does not concern the bee;
A clover, any time, to him
Is aristocracy.
